Package fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp3.set

Class SetExamples

java.lang.Object
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp3.set.SetExamples
public class SetExamples extends Object
Examples demonstrating Set implementations and common set operations.

Illustrates HashSet/LinkedHashSet/TreeSet characteristics, set algebra (union/intersection/difference), and immutability patterns.

  • Method Details

    • hashSetExample

      public static void hashSetExample()
      Demonstrates HashSet usage, including duplicate handling and iteration. The Person class must correctly implement equals() and hashCode() for this to work as expected. In case of a TreeSet instead of HashSet, Person must implement Comparable.

    • linkedHashSetExample

      public static void linkedHashSetExample()
      Demonstrates LinkedHashSet usage to maintain insertion order. Person class must implement equals() and hashCode() correctly. LinkedHashSet preserves the order in which elements were added.

    • treeSetExample

      public static void treeSetExample()
      Demonstrates TreeSet usage for sorting elements, both natural and by custom comparator. Person class must implement Comparable for natural ordering.

    • setOperationsExample

      public static void setOperationsExample()
      Demonstrates common set operations: union, intersection, difference, and symmetric difference.

    • removeDuplicatesExample

      public static void removeDuplicatesExample()
      Demonstrates removal of duplicates from a collection using Set implementations.

    • navigableSetExample

      public static void navigableSetExample()
      Demonstrates NavigableSet features like navigation methods and descending view. A NavigableSet is a SortedSet with additional navigation methods : lower, floor, ceiling, higher, and descendingSet.

    • immutableSetExample

      public static void immutableSetExample()
      Demonstrates immutable Set creation and attempts to modify it.
